name: filesystem promises lifecycle
source: import { mkdir, readFile, readdir, rm, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises'; async function main(): Promise<void> { const dir: string = '/tmp/thaw-node-fsp-compat'; await rm(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }); await mkdir(dir); await writeFile(dir + '/a.txt', 'hello'); console.log(await readFile(dir + '/a.txt', 'utf8'), (await readdir(dir)).join(',')); await rm(dir, { recursive: true }); }
